title: Transport of prescribed Weil filtrations by immersions and reduction
statement:
Fix a prime power $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$ as in [def-weil-punctual-weights]. On a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $S_0$ use the constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaves of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] on $S=S_0\times_{k_0}k$, with the common-stage constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Restrictions are the inverse images of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], open extension by zero is the compact-support direct image of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and closed direct image is the direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image], all with their induced Weil structures. 
Let $j_0:V_0\hookrightarrow S_0$ be open and $i_0:C_0\hookrightarrow S_0$ closed, with no complement condition; write $j,i$ for their geometric base changes to $k$. For either $T=j_!$ or $T=i_*$, $T$ is exact [def-galois-exact-functor] on constructible Weil hearts and preserves punctual $\iota$-purity of every real weight. Let $G$ be a constructible Weil sheaf on the source of $T$. For a particular finite filtration $0=G_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq G_n=G$ by constructible Weil subobjects, with quotient $Q_s=G_s/G_{s-1}$ pure of assigned weight $v_s$, its image is a filtration
$$0=T G_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq T G_n=T G,\qquad T G_s/T G_{s-1}\simeq T Q_s.$$
The displayed quotient isomorphisms are Weil isomorphisms, and the quotients are pure with the same assigned weights $v_s$. Thus either functor preserves mixedness and every common upper bound on this prescribed finite list, including repeated terms and zero quotients.

Let $e_0:C_0\hookrightarrow S_0$ instead be any surjective closed immersion, let $e$ be its geometric base change, and let $H$ be a constructible Weil sheaf on $S_0$. The actual adjunction unit
$$\eta_H:H\longrightarrow e_*e^*H$$
is a Weil isomorphism. Every specified finite mixed filtration $G_\bullet$ of $e^*H$ gives the filtration $\eta_H^{-1}(e_*G_\bullet)$ of $H$, with the same assigned pure quotient weights and upper bounds. In particular this applies to $e_0=r:(S_0)_{\mathrm{red}}\hookrightarrow S_0$, the reduction of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. No reality assumption or reducedness of $S_0$ is required.

proof.text: For the open immersion, apply [lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual]. It concerns exactly the rational/common-stage compact-support operation in the statement, gives an exact functor on constructible Weil sheaves, and gives preservation of punctual purity of each real weight. In particular the zero stalks outside the open introduce no eigenvalues. This invocation does not use the closed immersion $i_0$, so no complement condition between $j_0$ and $i_0$ is needed.

proof.text: The closed immersion $i$ is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]. Apply [lem-zl-finite-adic-direct-image] at $\Lambda=\Qlb$: the actual $Ri_*$ preserves the constructible standard heart and is exact on it. Equip it with its induced Weil structure. The Frobenius exchange and its normalization are the closed mate of [lem-sf-open-closed-weil-mate-structures], applied using the complement of $C_0$ (independently of $V_0$). Frobenius pullback is $t$-exact by [lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact], also for its inverse automorphism. Thus [lem-zl-texact-fixed-pair-heart-cohomology] makes this an exact functor on the abelian fixed-pair hearts, whose kernels and cokernels are created by forgetting the structure.

source.place: Final paragraph (exact immersion extension and gluing); reduction paragraph. Stacks 03QP, 09AH and 054M supply the finite-stalk, localization and reduction inputs through the cited nodes.

proof.text: For a closed point $x\in S_0$, the finite-stalk formula of [lem-zl-finite-adic-direct-image] identifies $(i_*G)_{\bar x}$ with a direct sum indexed by geometric points of $C$ over $\bar x$. For a closed immersion this set is empty outside $C_0$, and has exactly one element $\bar z$ on $C_0$: a field-valued point factors uniquely through a quotient ring exactly when its ideal vanishes. On $C_0$ the image point $z$ is closed and $\kappa(z)=\kappa(x)$, as also stated in [lem-zl-immersion-weil-local-behavior](1). Write $e_{\bar x}$ for the resulting restriction isomorphism to $G_{\bar z}$. Naturality of the finite-stalk restriction maps for semilinear isomorphisms identifies the Frobenius exchange with the same restriction map after moving $\bar x$ and $\bar z$ by Frobenius; naturality in $G$ identifies the maps induced by its structure. Therefore iterating the structure $n=[\kappa(x):k_0]$ times gives the same restriction map before and after that iterate. In the local-operator composite of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], the remaining point-transport squares commute by [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural](2). Composing these squares gives $e_{\bar x}F_x=F_z e_{\bar x}$. Hence the nonzero-stalk spectra are identical, with the same $q_x=q_z$. Zero stalks have no eigenvectors. By [def-weil-punctual-weights], $i_*$ preserves purity of every assigned real weight.

source.place: Final paragraph (exact immersion extension and gluing); reduction paragraph. Stacks 03QP, 09AH and 054M supply the finite-stalk, localization and reduction inputs through the cited nodes.

proof.text: For either exact Weil-heart functor $T$, apply [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology](a) to each monomorphism $G_{s-1}\hookrightarrow G_s$ and its cokernel $Q_s$. It gives monomorphisms $TG_{s-1}\hookrightarrow TG_s$ and the canonical quotient isomorphism $TG_s/TG_{s-1}\cong TQ_s$, compatible with the quotient projections. This is an isomorphism in the Weil heart itself, since that is the abelian category to which the exact-functor lemma is being applied. The initial object is zero and the final object is $TG$. Steps 1 and 3 make each quotient pure of precisely its original assigned weight $v_s$. This is the required filtration in [def-weil-punctual-weights]; every inequality $v_s\le w$ is unchanged. If adjacent terms coincide the quotient and its image are zero, which is pure of every weight by the absence of nonzero eigenvectors. The empty filtration is allowed for the zero object.

source.place: Final paragraph (exact immersion extension and gluing); reduction paragraph. Stacks 03QP, 09AH and 054M supply the finite-stalk, localization and reduction inputs through the cited nodes.

proof.text: Now take a surjective closed immersion $e_0:C_0\hookrightarrow S_0$. Its complementary open is empty. The common-stage localization triangle [prop-sf-open-closed-triangle-all-stages], applied to the underlying heart object $H$, has the actual closed adjunction unit as its second map and is Weil-equivariant. Its first term is zero: pullback to the empty scheme has zero geometric fibres and hence is zero by [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]; open extension of zero is zero by Step 1. Its last nonshifted term $e_*e^*H$ is in the heart by Step 2 and exact restriction [lem-zl-immersion-weil-local-behavior](1). Apply cohomology to this underlying distinguished triangle using [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](5). Since the first term and its shift are zero, the sequence in degree zero is $0\longrightarrow H\xrightarrow{\eta_H} e_*e^*H\longrightarrow0$, so the actual unit is invertible. It is already a Weil morphism; multiplying $\eta_H\theta_H=\theta_{e_*e^*H}F(\eta_H)$ by its inverse on both sides shows that the inverse also intertwines the structures. Thus this is a Weil isomorphism, without assuming a triangulated structure on the category of Weil pairs.

proof.text: Apply Step 4 with $T=e_*$ to the specified filtration $G_\bullet$ of $e^*H$. Put $K_s=\eta_H^{-1}(e_*G_s)$, where inverse image is pullback of the subobject along the Weil isomorphism of Step 5. Explicitly its inclusion is $e_*G_s\hookrightarrow e_*e^*H\xrightarrow{\eta_H^{-1}}H$; this representative is isomorphic to that pullback, so $K_0=0$, $K_n=H$, and $K_{s-1}\subseteq K_s$. The identification $K_s\cong e_*G_s$ commutes with inclusions. The cokernel universal property therefore gives $K_s/K_{s-1}\cong e_*G_s/e_*G_{s-1}\cong e_*(G_s/G_{s-1})$ in the Weil heart. Purity and the assigned bounds follow from Steps 3 and 4. Isomorphism preserves the local spectra: an equivariant isomorphism intertwines the iterated structure, and naturality of the point transport in Step 3 intertwines the local operator; its inverse takes nonzero eigenvectors back. Thus these are precisely the prescribed quotient weights, also for repeated terms.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-universal-homeomorphism], the actual reduction $(S_0)_{\mathrm{red}}\to S_0$ is a surjective closed immersion. Apply Steps 5 and 6 to this arrow and its geometric base change. This proves the reduction clause. The proof used no reality assumption, no reducedness, and no relation between the initially specified open and closed immersions.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q45-c683dae06 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the whole item, all 15 cited statements (and the blueprint_updates of prop-sf-open-closed-triangle-all-stages and lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles) and main-20261015 thm-zl-real-mixed-by-curves.proof.md lines 59-106, diffed against latest. Not a re-split order: there is no repair note. The statement and stmt_deps are identical to the Q58-created node. Old parent steps 2 and 7 are carried in full: steps 1-4 and 5-7. No new nodes and no fixes. Step 1: extension-by-zero-punctual gives exactness and purity for every real w, and its hypotheses hold. Step 2: closed-immersion-finite, then finite-adic-direct-image at Q̄_ℓ (exact on Sh_c), then the closed mate c from open-closed-weil-mate-structures applied with C_0's own complement, then the fixed-pair lemma (abelian hearts, kernels and cokernels created by forgetting). Frobenius t-exactness is cited from a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact although g_T is not k-linear; reviewed nodes use it the same way, and residue-compatible-pullback-frobenius states the fact, so I treat it as harmless. Step 3: the fibre of a closed immersion is empty or one point, also for nonreduced C_0. Residue fields are equal, so q_x=q_z and the weight is not rescaled. Point-transport naturality gives e F_x = F_z e. This is the f_x=1 case of the reviewed lem-zl-finite-pushforward argument. It overlaps the on-route node lem-zl-finite-pushforward-punctual, whose proof is native-WeilSheaf. Rederiving the fact in the common-stage heart avoids identifying the two coefficient categories, so I accept it; maintainer note on the overlap. Step 4: exact-functor lemma (a) in the Weil heart, plus conjugacy invariance of spectra. Step 5: the empty complement gives j^*H=0 by joint conservativity of fibres on the empty scheme. H^0 of the triangle (clause 5) makes η invertible, and its inverse is equivariant. No triangulated structure on Weil pairs is assumed. Step 6 is elementary. Step 7: the reduction is a surjective closed immersion and universal homeomorphism. Edge cases tested: thickening F_q[ε]/ε², empty V_0/C_0/S_0, zero sheaf, n=0, repeated and zero quotients, unordered weights. I accept the 7 declared tool_uses as generic coefficient tools. Batch 5: def-weil-local-frobenius-trace, def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves and def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data are definitions. lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison, lem-trf-adjoint-composition-coherence and lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-comparison-normalization are generic statements about t-structures, adjunctions and pullback normalization. None of them is a step of the trace-formula or Poincaré-duality proof, so all flagged citations are accepted. No SGA source is used.
